notes:
What’s new in 0.1.34:
• One sign-in for the whole family: everyone uses their own username and password in the phone app, at home and away — never yours.
• A smaller installer (164 MB instead of 256 MB), and from the next update on you’ll see download progress, time left, and the option to install when nobody’s watching.
• Backup and restore in Settings, with a preview and an automatic safety copy.
• Watched marks for any episode, season or show, and Continue Watching that updates straight away.
• Collections and “Request a title” for your household. New films get their posters again.
• Safer logins: stronger 8-character codes and limits on password guessing. After updating, open Users and press “New code” for anyone listed.
• Install Android 1.20 for the new sign-in screen, Android TV support, 21 new campsite games, and Wi-Fi-only downloads.
